article_title: 'I'd talk to the TV': The paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely

tasks.prompt: What is the central theme of the article?
options: China is replacing hospitals with delivery companies.
Paid companionship services are growing as people across generations experience loneliness and weakened support networks.
Most elderly people in China have decided to enter retirement homes.
Mountain tourism has become China's largest industry.
tasks.correct_answer: Paid companionship services are growing as people across generations experience loneliness and weakened support networks.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת את צמיחת שירותי הליווי בתשלום כתגובה לבדידות ולשינויים ברשתות התמיכה החברתיות בסין.

tasks.prompt: How does Wang Yingwei's team help older clients beyond delivering meals?
options: They arrange international holidays.
They provide practical help, companionship and repairs that make daily life easier.
They move every client into a nursing home.
They offer medical surgery at home.
tasks.correct_answer: They provide practical help, companionship and repairs that make daily life easier.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הצוות מספק קשר אנושי ועזרה מעשית, כגון התקנת מסנן מים או תיקון מקלחת וציוד ביתי.

tasks.prompt: What does “exacerbated” mean in the discussion of urban isolation?
options: Made worse
Completely solved
Carefully measured
Hidden from public view
tasks.explanation_hebrew: exacerbated פירושו הוחמרה; מבנה החברה ודפוסי האינטראקציה מגבירים את תחושת הבדידות.

tasks.prompt: Why do some young adults hire Liu Yanyan as a medical escort?
options: They want her to diagnose their illnesses.
Hospitals allow entry only with a paid escort.
They may feel anxious going alone or uncomfortable asking colleagues for help because of expected reciprocity.
She guarantees that they will receive test results immediately.
tasks.correct_answer: They may feel anxious going alone or uncomfortable asking colleagues for help because of expected reciprocity.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: צעירים מסוימים חוששים ללכת לבד או חשים שמבקשת עזרה מחבר תיצור מחויבות להחזיר טובה, ולכן משלמים למלווה.

tasks.prompt: Why might a paid service feel more predictable than friendship to some clients?
options: The service defines expected support without the same uncertainty or reciprocal obligations.
Paid companions are legally required to become family members.
Friendship is banned in large Chinese cities.
Clients can control every feeling of the companion.
tasks.correct_answer: The service defines expected support without the same uncertainty or reciprocal obligations.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בשירות בתשלום הציפיות מוגדרות יותר, והלקוח אינו נדרש להתמודד באותה מידה עם אי־ודאות או מחויבות הדדית.

tasks.prompt: What does “commodity” mean in the final discussion of human connection?
options: A private thought that cannot be shared
A basic human need that has also become something bought and sold
A government ban on companionship
A medical diagnosis caused by loneliness
tasks.correct_answer: A basic human need that has also become something bought and sold
tasks.explanation_hebrew: commodity הוא דבר בעל ערך שניתן לקנות ולמכור; הכתבה טוענת שקשר אנושי הפך גם לשירות מסחרי.

tasks.prompt: What social and personal factors does the article identify as causes of loneliness in China?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין הגירה מהכפר לעיר, מעבר בוגרים בעקבות עבודה, התרחקות ממשפחה וחברים, פרישה, אובדן בן זוג, לחץ חברתי וקושי לבקש עזרה.
expected_points: Rural migrants leave close-knit support networks for cities.
Graduates move across the country to pursue employment.
Older people may lose spouses, retire or live far from their children.
Fast-paced work, relationship pressures and expectations can leave people isolated or reluctant to seek informal help.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the different forms of paid companionship described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את ביקורי הבית והארוחות, הליווי הרפואי, ליווי הטיולים והתמיכה הרגשית, ואת הצורך המשותף שכל השירותים ממלאים.
expected_points: Wang Yingwei's team delivers meals, visits elderly clients and solves practical household problems.
Liu Yanyan accompanies clients to hospitals or collects tests and medication.
Wang Zhoutao guides hikers and offers encouragement, jokes and practical support.
All the services sell reliable human presence and emotional connection to people who feel isolated.

tasks.prompt: What benefits and risks can arise when human connection becomes a paid service?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג באופן מאוזן נגישות, צפיות ברורות וסיוע מעשי מול תלות, אי־שוויון ביחסים והעובדה ששירות פרטי אינו פותר את שורשי הבדידות.
expected_points: Paid services can provide reliable help and companionship when family or friends are unavailable.
Clear service expectations may reduce anxiety about reciprocity or disappointment.
Clients may become dependent on a provider they cannot afford indefinitely.
A commercial relationship is unequal and may address immediate isolation without repairing broader social support networks.

tasks.prompt: Write a concise proposal for a community programme inspired by the article but not based only on payment.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע חיבור קבוע בין מתנדבים לתושבים מבודדים, עזרה מעשית וליווי, הכשרה ובדיקות בטיחות, ומנגנון להפניה לשירותים מקצועיים.
expected_points: Create regular matched visits or calls for isolated older adults and newcomers.
Include practical help with errands, technology or appointments as well as conversation.
Train and screen volunteers and establish clear boundaries and safeguarding procedures.
Partner with health and community services for referrals when needs exceed volunteer support.
